title: The New Desire: Givaudan explores the impact of GLP-1 on consumers
summary: Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro: the names of these GLP-1-based medical treatments for diabetes and obesity have become commonplace. All around the world, their use is soaring and increasingly extending to aesthetic purposes, with significant implications for the beauty industry. Through the immersive exhibition called The New Desire, Givaudan's Digital Factory aimed to examine these phenomena and the resulting shifts in consumer behaviour. Here's Premium Beauty News' report.
